# VoxFrame 2.2.0 — shape the story, keep the soundtrack yours

This release brings the recent local studio improvements into a downloadable version.
Your recordings, projects and edits continue to stay on your computer.

## New in this release

- **Manual section edits:** choose exact start and end times in Pacing, keep just
  that section or remove it and close the gap. Use the playhead to set boundaries,
  preview short edits, and restore changes with Undo and Redo. Voice, footage and
  timed captions move together; Update video fits the soundtrack to the new length.
- **Separate audio tracks:** listen to and download the recorded voice and added
  music as individual WAVs from Sound. The music lane opens its controls directly.
  Independent music selection, level and ducking controls remain available after
  rendering, without replacing the pictures.
- **Story and visual direction:** compose passages, place visuals on specific
  words, compare rendered looks, and save coordinated caption and visual styles.
- **Opening and closing auditions:** preview complete bookend treatments, review
  their entrances and endings, then save reusable signatures for other recordings.
- **Bookend collections:** audition a signature across up to six finished
  recordings and export separate editable projects with each recording's own words,
  media and soundtrack.
- **Collection finishing review:** watch every finished clip, inspect metadata and
  recorded sound cues, open the relevant controls for fixes, and approve the
  current files before downloading videos, subtitle companions, credits and a
  review receipt in one ZIP.
- **Recent reliability and interface fixes:** model profile switching, media
  previews and downloads, exact transition lengths, project deletion, responsive
  scrolling, and reliable Story Composer and Undo/Redo browser checks.

## Using the new tools

Open **Pacing → Your cut. Your timing.** to keep or remove a section.
Open **Sound → Separate voice and music tracks** to listen to or download WAVs.
Open **Director → Bookend signature collection** to build and review a collection.

Audio downloads match the last finished render. The voice track includes audio
already in the uploaded recording; this release does not isolate music baked into
that recording. Added music is exported before mix gains and ducking. Save edits
and use **Update video** before downloading tracks for the new timeline.

Cuts snap to video frames. Trimming inside corrected captions requires restoring
those captions first, so corrections are not silently discarded. Review previews
and listen to finished exports before sharing.

## Downloads

The release workflow builds and tests the Windows installer and macOS Apple
Silicon DMG, attaches checksums and bundled FFmpeg source, then creates a draft
release for the maintainer to review and publish. The version change alone does
not replace the current public installers.
